module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSCoefficientPositive
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Positive

/-!
# The actual diagonal GNS coefficient as a positive continuous linear map

The existing bounded diagonal coefficient retains its exact continuous
linear map. Its original positive compressed-weight value proves positivity
for the canonical spectral orders, and linearity then proves monotonicity.
The standard positive continuous linear map bundles those same values.

This supplies the positive-map field needed for an actual positive normal
functional. Normal-functional membership and the computed representation's
ultraweak continuity remain separate; no normality assumption is used here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- The same original bounded diagonal coefficient has its actual positive continuous linear map. -/
def Weight.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    PositiveContinuousLinearMap ℂ A ℂ := by
  let ψ : StrongDual ℂ A :=
    representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) (φ.gnsMap x)
  have hpositive : ∀ a : A, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ ψ a := by
    intro a ha
    change 0 ≤ representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) (φ.gnsMap x) a
    rw [φ.gnsCoefficient_positive_value a ha x]
    let t : ℝ := (φ.value
      ⟨star (x : A) * a * (x : A), star_left_conjugate_nonneg ha (x : A)⟩).toReal
    let z : ℂ := RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt t)
    have ht : 0 ≤ t := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hz : star z = z := by
      change (starRingEnd ℂ) (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt t) : ℂ) = _
      exact RCLike.conj_ofReal (K := ℂ) (Real.sqrt t)
    have hcast : (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt t * Real.sqrt t) : ℂ) =
        (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt t) : ℂ) * (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt t) : ℂ) :=
      RCLike.ofReal_mul (K := ℂ) (Real.sqrt t) (Real.sqrt t)
    have hsquare : star z * z = (RCLike.ofReal t : ℂ) := by
      calc
        star z * z = z * z := by rw [hz]
        _ = (RCLike.ofReal (Real.sqrt t * Real.sqrt t) : ℂ) := hcast.symm
        _ = (RCLike.ofReal t : ℂ) :=
          congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ)) (Real.mul_self_sqrt ht)
    change 0 ≤ (RCLike.ofReal t : ℂ)
    rw [← hsquare]
    exact star_mul_self_nonneg z
  exact
    { __ := ψ
      monotone' := by
        intro a b hab
        have h := hpositive (b - a) (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)
        rw [map_sub] at h
        exact sub_nonneg.mp h }

/-- Forgetting positivity retains exactly the existing bounded diagonal representation coefficient. -/
theorem Weight.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional_toContinuousLinearMap (φ : Weight A)
    (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    (φ.gnsDiagonalPositiveFunctional x).toContinuousLinearMap =
      representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) (φ.gnsMap x) :=
  rfl

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.FiniteSquareSubmodule
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order

/-!
# Finite positive squares and positive compression values for scalar weights

The original global weight on a possibly nonunital C-star algebra gives
finite square values for its finite-positive elements. Their complex span
lies in the exact finite-square module. Every positive compression by a
finite-square element has finite weight, from the canonical conjugation
norm bound and the original weight laws.

These generic APIs use only the original algebra, positive domain and
scalar weight. Concrete von Neumann topology and representation suppliers
consume them through this neutral owner.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

universe uA

variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- The original positive square is bounded by the original positive norm multiple. -/
theorem positive_mul_self_le_norm_smul (a : PositiveElement A) :
    (a : A) * (a : A) ≤ ‖(a : A)‖ • (a : A) := by
  let r : A := CFC.sqrt (a : A)
  have hstar : star r = r := IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (a : A))
  have hsquare : r * r = (a : A) := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self (a : A) a.property
  have hconjugate := CStarAlgebra.star_left_conjugate_le_norm_smul r (a : A)
    (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg a.property)
  have hproduct : star r * (a : A) * r = (a : A) * (a : A) := by
    rw [hstar, ← hsquare]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  calc
    (a : A) * (a : A) = star r * (a : A) * r := hproduct.symm
    _ ≤ ‖(a : A)‖ • (star r * r) := hconjugate
    _ = ‖(a : A)‖ • (a : A) := by rw [hstar, hsquare]

/-- Original finite-positive elements belong to the same literal finite-square domain. -/
theorem Weight.finitePositiveElements_subset_finiteSquareDomain (φ : Weight A) :
    φ.finitePositiveElements ⊆ φ.finiteSquareDomain := by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨haPositive, haFinite⟩ := ha
  let p : PositiveElement A := ⟨a, haPositive⟩
  have hstar : star a = a := IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg haPositive
  have hbound : (leftSquare a : A) ≤
      (positiveSmul (NNReal.mk ‖a‖ (norm_nonneg a)) p : A) := by
    change star a * a ≤ ‖a‖ • a
    rw [hstar]
    exact positive_mul_self_le_norm_smul p
  exact φ.finite_of_le (leftSquare a)
    (positiveSmul (NNReal.mk ‖a‖ (norm_nonneg a)) p) hbound
    (φ.finite_positiveSmul (NNReal.mk ‖a‖ (norm_nonneg a)) p haFinite)

/-- The original finite-positive integration span lies in the actual finite-square module. -/
theorem Weight.finiteIntegrationDomain_le_finiteSquareSubmodule (φ : Weight A) :
    φ.finiteIntegrationDomain ≤ φ.finiteSquareSubmodule := by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  intro a ha
  exact φ.finitePositiveElements_subset_finiteSquareDomain ha


/-- A literal finite-square element gives finite weight to every original positive compression. -/
theorem Weight.value_positiveConjugate_lt_top (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule)
    (a : PositiveElement A) :
    φ.value ⟨star (x : A) * (a : A) * (x : A),
      star_left_conjugate_nonneg a.property (x : A)⟩ < ⊤ := by
  let r : NNReal := NNReal.mk ‖(a : A)‖ (norm_nonneg (a : A))
  have hbound : star (x : A) * (a : A) * (x : A) ≤
      (positiveSmul r (leftSquare (x : A)) : A) := by
    change star (x : A) * (a : A) * (x : A) ≤ ‖(a : A)‖ • (star (x : A) * (x : A))
    exact CStarAlgebra.star_left_conjugate_le_norm_smul (x : A) (a : A)
      (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg a.property)
  exact φ.finite_of_le _ (positiveSmul r (leftSquare (x : A))) hbound
    (φ.finite_positiveSmul r (leftSquare (x : A)) x.property)


end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.PreInnerProduct
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Basic

/-!
# The actual weight seminorm and faithful pre-GNS norm

The proved scalar-weight pre-inner-product Core supplies the stock
seminormed additive group and complex inner-product structure on the
literal pre-GNS type copy. Its norm is the square root of the original
finite positive-square weight value, with no ambient norm substitution.

The original positive-weight faithfulness law proves definiteness:
a zero diagonal has finite square value zero, hence its original positive
square is zero, and the C-star proper-star law forces the original element
to be zero. The stock definite-Core factory constructs the faithful normed
additive group. The same actual pre-inner-product structure is retained.
No norm/inner/Hilbert certificate or existence theorem is supplied as input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual weight Core gives its original induced seminorm and distance. -/
instance Weight.preGNSSeminormedAddCommGroup (φ : Weight A) : SeminormedAddCommGroup φ.PreGNS :=
  InnerProductSpace.Core.toSeminormedAddCommGroup (c := φ.preGNSPreInnerProduct)

/-- The same proved Core gives the actual complex pre-inner-product structure. -/
instance Weight.preGNSInnerProductSpace (φ : Weight A) : InnerProductSpace ℂ φ.PreGNS :=
  InnerProductSpace.ofCore φ.preGNSPreInnerProduct

/-- The induced inner product retains the original scalar-weight polarization values. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.preGNS_inner (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.PreGNS) :
    ⟪x, y⟫_ℂ = φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x) (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv y) :=
  rfl

/-- The induced norm is the square root of the original finite positive-square value. -/
theorem Weight.preGNS_norm (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    ‖x‖ = Real.sqrt (φ.finiteSquareValue (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x)) := by
  change Real.sqrt (RCLike.re (φ.finiteSquarePolarInner
    (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x) (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x))) =
      Real.sqrt (φ.finiteSquareValue (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x))
  rw [φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_self, RCLike.ofReal_re]

/-- The actual pre-GNS norm square equals the original finite weight value. -/
theorem Weight.preGNS_norm_sq (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = φ.finiteSquareValue (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x) := by
  rw [φ.preGNS_norm]
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (φ.finiteSquareValue_nonneg _)

/-- Original positive-weight faithfulness proves the actual diagonal is definite. -/
theorem Weight.preGNS_definite (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x : φ.PreGNS) (hx : φ.preGNSPreInnerProduct.inner x x = 0) : x = 0 := by
  let y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule := φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x
  have hreal := congrArg (fun z : ℂ => RCLike.re z) hx
  change RCLike.re (φ.finiteSquarePolarInner y y) = RCLike.re (0 : ℂ) at hreal
  rw [φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_self, RCLike.ofReal_re, map_zero] at hreal
  have hfinite : φ.value (leftSquare (y : A)) < ⊤ := y.property
  change (φ.value (leftSquare (y : A))).toReal = 0 at hreal
  have hvalue : φ.value (leftSquare (y : A)) = 0 :=
    ((ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff _).1 hreal).resolve_right hfinite.ne
  have hsquare : star (y : A) * (y : A) = 0 := hφ (leftSquare (y : A)) hvalue
  have hy : (y : A) = 0 := star_mul_self_eq_zero.mp hsquare
  apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
  rw [map_zero]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hy

/-- The genuine faithful Core retains the same weight kernel and proved definite field. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def Weight.faithfulPreGNSCore (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    InnerProductSpace.Core ℂ φ.PreGNS where
  __ := φ.preGNSPreInnerProduct
  definite x hx := φ.preGNS_definite hφ x hx

/-- The stock definite-Core factory gives the actual faithful weight normed group. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def Weight.faithfulPreGNSNormedAddCommGroup (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    NormedAddCommGroup φ.PreGNS :=
  InnerProductSpace.Core.toNormedAddCommGroup (cd := φ.faithfulPreGNSCore hφ)

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.FiniteValueRelations
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Completion
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
public import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# The actual weight polarization on its original finite-square domain

Finite-positive signed relations prove the Hermitian, additive and scalar
laws of the literal global-weight polarization. Its diagonal is exactly
the original finite square value. These proofs construct the actual
pre-inner-product core, with no supplied scalar extension or inner certificate.

A type copy of the original finite-square module prevents its ambient
operator norm from being confused with the weight-induced norm. The
pre-inner-product Core below is constructed from the proved scalar kernel.
The induced norm, faithfulness, normality, completion representation and Tomita data
remain separate obligations; no original source theorem is selected as DATA.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- The original square difference is the symmetric sum of its two cross terms. -/
theorem leftSquare_difference (x y : A) :
    (leftSquare (x + y) : A) - (leftSquare (x - y) : A) =
      (star x * y + star y * x) + (star x * y + star y * x) := by
  simp only [leftSquare, star_add, star_sub, add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub]
  abel

/-- The finite-square value at zero is the original weight value at zero. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquareValue_zero (φ : Weight A) : φ.finiteSquareValue 0 = 0 := by
  have hzero : leftSquare (0 : A) = positiveZero A := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [leftSquare, positiveZero, star_zero, zero_mul]
  change (φ.value (leftSquare (0 : A))).toReal = 0
  rw [hzero, φ.zero_value, ENNReal.toReal_zero]

/-- Every finite-square value is a genuinely nonnegative real number. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquareValue_nonneg (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    0 ≤ φ.finiteSquareValue x :=
  ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

/-- Taking the original negative does not change the original positive square value. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquareValue_neg (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquareValue (-x) = φ.finiteSquareValue x := by
  have hneg : leftSquare (-(x : A)) = leftSquare (x : A) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [leftSquare, star_neg, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg]
  change (φ.value (leftSquare (-(x : A)))).toReal = (φ.value (leftSquare (x : A))).toReal
  rw [hneg]

/-- Original complex scaling changes the finite square by exactly its scalar norm square. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquareValue_smul (φ : Weight A) (c : ℂ) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquareValue (c • x) = ‖c‖ ^ 2 * φ.finiteSquareValue x := by
  have hsquare : leftSquare (c • (x : A)) =
      positiveSmul (NNReal.mk (‖c‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖c‖)) (leftSquare (x : A)) :=
    leftSquare_smul c (x : A)
  have hvalue := congrArg (fun z : PositiveElement A => (φ.value z).toReal) hsquare
  change (φ.value (leftSquare (c • (x : A)))).toReal =
    ‖c‖ ^ 2 * (φ.value (leftSquare (x : A))).toReal
  exact hvalue.trans (φ.toReal_positiveSmul (NNReal.mk (‖c‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖c‖)) (leftSquare (x : A)))

/-- Real polarization of the original finite square is zero at the zero first argument. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_zero (φ : Weight A) (y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe 0 y = 0 := by
  simp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, zero_add, zero_sub, φ.finiteSquareValue_neg,
    sub_self, zero_div]

/-- Original finite-positive difference addition proves additivity of the real pairing. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_add (φ : Weight A) (x y z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (x + y) z = φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x z + φ.finiteSquarePolarRe y z := by
  have hraw :
      (leftSquare (((x + y) + z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare (((x + y) - z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) =
      ((leftSquare ((x + z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((x - z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A)) +
      ((leftSquare ((y + z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((y - z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A)) := by
    change (leftSquare ((x : A) + (y : A) + (z : A)) : A) -
      (leftSquare ((x : A) + (y : A) - (z : A)) : A) =
      ((leftSquare ((x : A) + (z : A)) : A) - (leftSquare ((x : A) - (z : A)) : A)) +
      ((leftSquare ((y : A) + (z : A)) : A) - (leftSquare ((y : A) - (z : A)) : A))
    simp only [leftSquare_difference, star_add, add_mul, mul_add]
    abel
  have h := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_add_sub
    (leftSquare (((x + y) + z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare (((x + y) - z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x + z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x - z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((y + z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((y - z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (x + y + z).property (x + y - z).property (x + z).property (x - z).property
    (y + z).property (y - z).property hraw
  dsimp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, Weight.finiteSquareValue]
  linarith [h]

/-- Negating the original first argument negates the actual real pairing. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_neg (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (-x) y = -φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y := by
  have h := φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_add x (-x) y
  rw [add_neg_cancel, φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_zero] at h
  linarith

/-- The actual real pairing is symmetric by the original star-product difference identity. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_symm (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y = φ.finiteSquarePolarRe y x := by
  have hraw :
      (leftSquare ((x + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((x - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) =
      (leftSquare ((y + x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((y - x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) := by
    change (leftSquare ((x : A) + (y : A)) : A) - (leftSquare ((x : A) - (y : A)) : A) =
      (leftSquare ((y : A) + (x : A)) : A) - (leftSquare ((y : A) - (x : A)) : A)
    simp only [leftSquare_difference]
    abel
  have h := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_sub
    (leftSquare ((x + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((y + x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((y - x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (x + y).property (x - y).property (y + x).property (y - x).property hraw
  dsimp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, Weight.finiteSquareValue]
  linarith [h]

/-- Original real scalar multiplication scales the actual real pairing. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_smul_real (φ : Weight A) (r : ℝ)
    (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) y = r * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y := by
  have hscalar : (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • (x : A) = r • (x : A) :=
    (RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ) r (x : A)).symm
  have hraw :
      (leftSquare ((((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) =
      r • ((leftSquare ((x + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((x - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A)) := by
    change (leftSquare ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • (x : A) + (y : A)) : A) -
      (leftSquare ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • (x : A) - (y : A)) : A) =
      r • ((leftSquare ((x : A) + (y : A)) : A) - (leftSquare ((x : A) - (y : A)) : A))
    rw [hscalar]
    simp only [leftSquare_difference, star_smul, star_trivial, smul_mul_assoc,
      mul_smul_comm, smul_add]
  have h := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_real_smul_sub r
    (leftSquare ((((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) + y).property (((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) - y).property
    (x + y).property (x - y).property hraw
  dsimp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, Weight.finiteSquareValue]
  linarith [h]

/-- The original imaginary cross difference changes sign when the arguments are exchanged. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_I_antisymm (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y = -φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • y) x := by
  have hraw :
      (leftSquare (((Complex.I • x) + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare (((Complex.I • x) - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) =
      (leftSquare (((Complex.I • y) - x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare (((Complex.I • y) + x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) := by
    change (leftSquare (Complex.I • (x : A) + (y : A)) : A) -
      (leftSquare (Complex.I • (x : A) - (y : A)) : A) =
      (leftSquare (Complex.I • (y : A) - (x : A)) : A) -
      (leftSquare (Complex.I • (y : A) + (x : A)) : A)
    have hreverse :
        (leftSquare (Complex.I • (y : A) - (x : A)) : A) -
          (leftSquare (Complex.I • (y : A) + (x : A)) : A) =
        -((leftSquare (Complex.I • (y : A) + (x : A)) : A) -
          (leftSquare (Complex.I • (y : A) - (x : A)) : A)) := by abel
    rw [hreverse]
    simp only [leftSquare_difference, star_smul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_I,
      neg_smul, neg_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
    abel
  have h := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_sub
    (leftSquare (((Complex.I • x) + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare (((Complex.I • x) - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare (((Complex.I • y) - x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare (((Complex.I • y) + x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    ((Complex.I • x) + y).property ((Complex.I • x) - y).property
    ((Complex.I • y) - x).property ((Complex.I • y) + x).property hraw
  dsimp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, Weight.finiteSquareValue]
  linarith [h]

/-- The actual complex polarization is Hermitian. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_conj_symm (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ.finiteSquarePolarInner y x) = φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x y := by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Complex.conj_re]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe y x = φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_symm y x
  · rw [Complex.conj_im]
    change -φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • y) x = φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y
    have h := φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_I_antisymm y x
    linarith

/-- The actual complex polarization is additive in the original first argument. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_add (φ : Weight A) (x y z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (x + y) z = φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x z + φ.finiteSquarePolarInner y z := by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Complex.add_re]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (x + y) z = φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x z + φ.finiteSquarePolarRe y z
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_add x y z
  · rw [Complex.add_im]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • (x + y)) z =
      φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) z + φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • y) z
    rw [smul_add]
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_add (Complex.I • x) (Complex.I • y) z

/-- Real scalars act on the actual complex pairing by their original real embedding. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul_real (φ : Weight A) (r : ℝ)
    (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) y =
      (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) * φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x y := by
  have hcomm : Complex.I • ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) =
      (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • (Complex.I • x) := smul_comm Complex.I (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) x
  have hre : (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ).re = r := by
    simpa only [RCLike.re_to_complex] using (RCLike.ofReal_re (K := ℂ) r)
  have him : (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ).im = 0 := by
    simpa only [RCLike.im_to_complex] using (RCLike.ofReal_im (K := ℂ) r)
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Complex.mul_re, hre, him]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x) y =
      r * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y - 0 * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y
    rw [zero_mul, sub_zero]
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_smul_real r x y
  · rw [Complex.mul_im, hre, him]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • ((RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) • x)) y =
      r * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y + 0 * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y
    rw [hcomm, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_smul_real r (Complex.I • x) y

/-- Multiplication of the first argument by i gives the original conjugate-linear sign. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul_I (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (Complex.I • x) y = -Complex.I * φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x y := by
  have hII : Complex.I • (Complex.I • x) = -x := by
    rw [smul_smul, Complex.I_mul_I, neg_one_smul]
  apply Complex.ext
  · rw [Complex.mul_re]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y =
      (-Complex.I).re * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y -
        (-Complex.I).im * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y
    simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  · rw [Complex.mul_im]
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • (Complex.I • x)) y =
      (-Complex.I).re * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y +
        (-Complex.I).im * φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y
    rw [hII, φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_neg]
    simp only [Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring

/-- Every original complex scalar acts conjugate linearly in the first argument. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul (φ : Weight A) (c : ℂ) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (c • x) y = (starRingEnd ℂ) c * φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x y := by
  let r : ℝ := RCLike.re c
  let s : ℝ := RCLike.im c
  have hc : c = (RCLike.ofReal r : ℂ) + (RCLike.ofReal s : ℂ) * Complex.I :=
    (RCLike.re_add_im c).symm
  rw [hc, add_smul, φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_add,
    ← smul_smul (RCLike.ofReal s : ℂ) Complex.I x,
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul_real r, φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul_real s,
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul_I]
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, RCLike.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
  ring

/-- The real diagonal is exactly the original finite square weight value. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_self (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x x = φ.finiteSquareValue x := by
  have htwo : x + x = (2 : ℂ) • x := (two_smul ℂ x).symm
  simp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, htwo, sub_self, φ.finiteSquareValue_zero,
    φ.finiteSquareValue_smul]
  norm_num

/-- The actual complex diagonal is the original positive scalar weight value. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_self (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x x = (RCLike.ofReal (φ.finiteSquareValue x) : ℂ) := by
  have him := φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_I_antisymm x x
  have hre : (RCLike.ofReal (φ.finiteSquareValue x) : ℂ).re = φ.finiteSquareValue x := by
    simpa only [RCLike.re_to_complex] using (RCLike.ofReal_re (K := ℂ) (φ.finiteSquareValue x))
  have himzero : (RCLike.ofReal (φ.finiteSquareValue x) : ℂ).im = 0 := by
    simpa only [RCLike.im_to_complex] using (RCLike.ofReal_im (K := ℂ) (φ.finiteSquareValue x))
  apply Complex.ext
  · change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x x = (RCLike.ofReal (φ.finiteSquareValue x) : ℂ).re
    rw [φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_self, hre]
  · change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) x =
      (RCLike.ofReal (φ.finiteSquareValue x) : ℂ).im
    rw [himzero]
    linarith

/-- A type copy of the exact original linear domain for the induced weight norm. -/
def Weight.PreGNS (φ : Weight A) : Type u := φ.finiteSquareSubmodule

/-- The pre-GNS copy has exactly the original finite-square additive group. -/
instance Weight.preGNSAddCommGroup (φ : Weight A) : AddCommGroup φ.PreGNS :=
  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup φ.finiteSquareSubmodule)

/-- The pre-GNS copy has exactly the original complex scalar action. -/
instance Weight.preGNSModule (φ : Weight A) : Module ℂ φ.PreGNS :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ φ.finiteSquareSubmodule)

/-- The pre-GNS copy forgets to exactly the original finite-square module. -/
def Weight.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ : Weight A) : φ.PreGNS ≃ₗ[ℂ] φ.finiteSquareSubmodule where
  toFun x := x
  invFun x := x
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

/-- The actual pre-inner-product fields are proved from the original scalar weight values. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def Weight.preGNSPreInnerProduct (φ : Weight A) : PreInnerProductSpace.Core ℂ φ.PreGNS where
  inner x y := φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x) (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv y)
  conj_inner_symm x y := φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_conj_symm _ _
  re_inner_nonneg x := by
    rw [φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_self, RCLike.ofReal_re]
    exact φ.finiteSquareValue_nonneg _
  add_left x y z := by
    rw [map_add]
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_add _ _ _
  smul_left x y c := by
    change φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (c • x)) (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv y) = _
    rw [map_smul]
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_smul _ _ _

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.Submodule.Equiv
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.Module

/-!
# The original weight core and its pre-Tomita operator

The original two-square-finite star algebra maps to the actual weight GNS
completion by the same canonical finite-square map. Original positive-zero
faithfulness makes this map injective. Its literal image is the complex
operator domain. Transporting the original algebra star through the stock
injective range equivalence gives the exact semilinear involution
`Lambda(x) -> Lambda(star x)` on that image.

The domain carries the norm inherited from the weight completion. The
ambient algebra norm is not used to claim continuity of the weight map
or its star operation. Density, closability, a closed Tomita operator,
polar decomposition and modular actions are separate source obligations.
No representation, integration extension or operator is selected from an
open source theorem. The stock inverse of an injective map identifies
unique original core elements in its literal range.

Source: Connes, Noncommutative Geometry (1994), V.3 Definition 6 and the
original NSF-weight algebra paragraph; preserved OCR 14358--14386,
SHA256 e968b4b9604a8b9a789a202dbb0f241793c10958a8a6962bc367e67a4820b9b3.
The source first-variable inner product phi(y*x) is transported by argument
reversal to the fixed Lean convention phi(x*y); the star operation stays
unchanged. This raw domain/operator supplies the actual object needed to
state the source closability and modular polar conclusions.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original two-square-finite core maps by the same canonical finite-square GNS map. -/
def Weight.finiteStarSquareGNSMap (φ : Weight A) : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra →ₗ[ℂ] φ.GNS :=
  φ.gnsMap.comp (LinearMap.codRestrict φ.finiteSquareSubmodule
    φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra.toSubmodule.subtype fun x => x.property.1)

/-- The core map preserves the original element and its actual canonical GNS value. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.finiteStarSquareGNSMap_apply (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap x = φ.gnsMap ⟨(x : A), x.property.1⟩ :=
  rfl

/-- Original positive-zero faithfulness makes the actual two-square core map injective. -/
theorem Weight.finiteStarSquareGNSMap_injective (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    Function.Injective φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap := by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := φ.gnsMap_injective hφ hxy
  exact congrArg (fun z : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule => (z : A)) h

/-- The pre-Tomita domain is exactly the original two-square core image in the weight completion. -/
def Weight.tomitaCore (φ : Weight A) : Submodule ℂ φ.GNS :=
  LinearMap.range φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap

/-- Actual domain membership is precisely an original finite-star-square GNS image. -/
theorem Weight.mem_tomitaCore (φ : Weight A) (ξ : φ.GNS) :
    ξ ∈ φ.tomitaCore ↔ ∃ x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra, φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap x = ξ :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- The stock injective range equivalence identifies the unique original element of the actual core. -/
def Weight.tomitaCoreEquiv (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra ≃ₗ[ℂ] φ.tomitaCore :=
  LinearEquiv.ofInjective φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap (φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap_injective hφ)

/-- The literal core identification has the same original canonical coefficient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreEquiv_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x : φ.GNS) = φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap x :=
  rfl

/-- Original star transports to the same conjugate-linear involution on the literal GNS core. -/
def Weight.preTomitaCore (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    φ.tomitaCore ≃ₗ⋆[ℂ] φ.tomitaCore :=
  ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm.trans (starLinearEquiv ℂ)).trans (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ)

/-- The actual core involution sends the original Lambda(x) exactly to Lambda(star x). -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaCore_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    φ.preTomitaCore hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) = φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ (star x) := by
  change φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ (star ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- Applying the original core star twice returns every actual domain vector. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaCore_involutive (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    Function.Involutive (φ.preTomitaCore hφ) := by
  intro ξ
  change φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ
    (star ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
      (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ (star ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ))))) = ξ
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, star_star, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The original pre-Tomita operator maps its literal domain into the same weight GNS completion. -/
def Weight.preTomitaOperator (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    φ.tomitaCore →ₗ⋆[ℂ] φ.GNS :=
  φ.tomitaCore.subtype.comp (φ.preTomitaCore hφ).toLinearMap

/-- The raw operator has precisely the original star value on every actual two-square core element. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaOperator_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    φ.preTomitaOperator hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) = φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap (star x) := by
  change (φ.preTomitaCore hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) : φ.GNS) = _
  rw [φ.preTomitaCore_apply]
  rfl

/-- The original involution and literal range inclusion make the raw operator injective. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaOperator_injective (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    Function.Injective (φ.preTomitaOperator hφ) :=
  Subtype.coe_injective.comp (φ.preTomitaCore hφ).injective

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.LinearPMap

/-!
# The original pre-Tomita operator as stock partial maps

The original two-square GNS image is the domain of the same semilinear
pre-Tomita operator. This file bundles it as the existing complex
`LinearPMap` and as a real-linear `LinearPMap` on the same actual carrier.
Complex conjugation fixes real scalars, so the real view keeps every
original operator value. The norm and topology are those of the same
weight Hilbert completion.

The real view lets Connes V.3 Definition 6 state closability using stock
`LinearPMap.IsClosable`. No parallel closability predicate, selected closed
operator, density, closability proof or modular/polar data is introduced.
Source: Connes, Noncommutative Geometry (1994), V.3 Definition 6 and the
original NSF-weight core paragraph, preserved OCR 14358--14386.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The stock complex partial map has the original weight core and semilinear pre-Tomita values. -/
def Weight.preTomitaPMap (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    φ.GNS →ₛₗ.[starRingEnd ℂ] φ.GNS where
  domain := φ.tomitaCore
  toFun := φ.preTomitaOperator hφ

/-- The complex partial map retains exactly the original two-square GNS image domain. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.preTomitaPMap_domain (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    (φ.preTomitaPMap hφ).domain = φ.tomitaCore :=
  rfl

/-- The stock complex partial map has every original starred GNS coefficient value. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaPMap_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    φ.preTomitaPMap hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) = φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap (star x) :=
  φ.preTomitaOperator_apply hφ x

/-- The original raw operator as a stock real partial map on the same weighted Hilbert carrier. -/
def Weight.preTomitaRealPMap (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    φ.GNS →ₗ.[ℝ] φ.GNS where
  domain := φ.tomitaCore.restrictScalars ℝ
  toFun := {
    toFun ξ := φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ⟨ξ.val, ξ.property⟩
    map_add' := by
      intro ξ η
      change φ.preTomitaOperator hφ
        ((⟨ξ.val, ξ.property⟩ : φ.tomitaCore) + ⟨η.val, η.property⟩) = _
      exact (φ.preTomitaOperator hφ).map_add _ _
    map_smul' := by
      intro c ξ
      let ζ : φ.tomitaCore := ⟨ξ.val, ξ.property⟩
      change φ.preTomitaOperator hφ (c • ζ) = c • φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ζ
      rw [← algebraMap_smul ℂ c ζ]
      have hs : φ.preTomitaOperator hφ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ c • ζ) =
          star (algebraMap ℝ ℂ c) • φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ζ :=
        (φ.preTomitaOperator hφ).map_smul' (algebraMap ℝ ℂ c) ζ
      have hc : star (algebraMap ℝ ℂ c) = algebraMap ℝ ℂ c := by simp
      calc
        φ.preTomitaOperator hφ (algebraMap ℝ ℂ c • ζ) =
            star (algebraMap ℝ ℂ c) • φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ζ := hs
        _ = c • φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ζ := by
          rw [hc]
          exact algebraMap_smul ℂ c (φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ζ)
  }

/-- The real view changes only the scalar field of the same original complex domain. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.preTomitaRealPMap_domain (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    (φ.preTomitaRealPMap hφ).domain = φ.tomitaCore.restrictScalars ℝ :=
  rfl

/-- Every actual real-domain vector keeps exactly the original pre-Tomita operator value. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaRealPMap_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ : φ.tomitaCore.restrictScalars ℝ) :
    φ.preTomitaRealPMap hφ ξ = φ.preTomitaOperator hφ ⟨ξ.val, ξ.property⟩ :=
  rfl

/-- The real partial map keeps the same original Lambda(x) to Lambda(star x) formula. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaRealPMap_originalValue (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    φ.preTomitaRealPMap hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) = φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap (star x) :=
  φ.preTomitaOperator_apply hφ x

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

Finite nonnegative scalars multiply the original extended-positive weight
values. The weight carrier and its canonical positive cone belong to the
same possibly nonunital C-star algebra. The constructor laws give the
actual scalar monoid action; the standard unit-action API restricts it to
the positive finite-real group.

/-- The actual global weight obtained by multiplying every original positive value by `r`. -/
def Weight.scale (r : NNReal) (φ : Weight A) : Weight A where
  value a := (r : ENNReal) * φ.value a
  zero_value := by
    rw [φ.zero_value, mul_zero]
  add_value a b := by
    rw [φ.add_value, mul_add]
  smul_value t a := by
    rw [φ.smul_value]
    exact mul_left_comm (r : ENNReal) (t : ENNReal) (φ.value a)

    (Weight.scale r φ).value a = (r : ENNReal) * φ.value a :=
  rfl

  apply Weight.ext_value
  intro a
  rw [Weight.scale_value, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul]

    Weight.scale (r * t) φ = Weight.scale r (Weight.scale t φ) := by
  apply Weight.ext_value
  intro a
  rw [Weight.scale_value, Weight.scale_value, Weight.scale_value, ENNReal.coe_mul, mul_assoc]

/-- The original scalar maps form their actual monoid action on global weights. -/
instance instMulActionWeight : MulAction NNReal (Weight A) where
  smul := Weight.scale
  one_smul := Weight.scale_one
  mul_smul := Weight.scale_mul

theorem Weight.units_smul_value (r : NNRealˣ) (φ : Weight A) (a : PositiveElement A) :

end

@[expose] public section

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

/-- The actual weighted core product is the original ambient algebra product under its fixed image map. -/
def Weight.tomitaCoreProduct (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ η : φ.tomitaCore) : φ.tomitaCore :=
  φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ * (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm η)

/-- Inverse image of the weighted product is exactly the original two-square algebra product. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreProduct_inverse (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ η : φ.tomitaCore) :
    (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm (φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ ξ η) =
      (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ * (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm η := by
  exact (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm_apply_apply _

/-- Original source elements retain their actual original multiplication in the weighted image. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreProduct_original (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (x y : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ y) =
      φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ (x * y) := by
  change φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ
    ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ x) *
      (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ y)) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- The original algebraic ring laws use the existing weighted image addition and scalar structures. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def Weight.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    NonUnitalRing φ.tomitaCore := by
  letI : Mul φ.tomitaCore := ⟨φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ⟩
  let e := (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
  exact Function.Injective.nonUnitalRing e e.injective
    (map_zero e) (fun ξ η => map_add e ξ η)
    (fun ξ η => φ.tomitaCoreProduct_inverse hφ ξ η)
    (fun ξ => map_neg e ξ) (fun ξ η => map_sub e ξ η)
    (fun n ξ => map_nsmul e n ξ) (fun n ξ => map_zsmul e n ξ)

/-- The transported ring keeps exactly the additive group underlying the existing weighted norm. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing_addGroup (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    (φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ).toAddCommGroup =
      (inferInstance : AddCommGroup φ.tomitaCore) :=
  rfl

/-- The original weighted core star is its already constructed pre-Tomita involution. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def Weight.tomitaCoreStar (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) : Star φ.tomitaCore where
  star := φ.preTomitaCore hφ

/-- Inverse image of the weighted star is the original source algebra star. -/
theorem Weight.preTomitaCore_inverse (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ : φ.tomitaCore) :
    (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm (φ.preTomitaCore hφ ξ) =
      star ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ) := by
  change (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
    (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ (star ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ))) = _
  exact (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm_apply_apply _

/-- Original star-ring laws hold on the actual weighted algebra with its original addition. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def Weight.tomitaCoreStarRing (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    StarRing φ.tomitaCore := by
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  let e := (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
  exact Function.Injective.starRing e e.injective
    (fun ξ => φ.preTomitaCore_inverse hφ ξ)
    (fun ξ η => map_add e ξ η)
    (fun ξ η => φ.tomitaCoreProduct_inverse hφ ξ η)

/-- The weighted source star has its original conjugate complex-scalar compatibility. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreStarModule (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    StarModule ℂ φ.tomitaCore := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  let e := (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
  exact Function.Injective.starModule e ℂ e.injective
    (fun ξ => φ.preTomitaCore_inverse hφ ξ)
    (fun c ξ => e.map_smul c ξ)

/-- The same existing complex scalar action is compatible with original product in its first factor. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreProduct_smul_left (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (c : ℂ) (ξ η : φ.tomitaCore) :
    φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ (c • ξ) η = c • φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ ξ η := by
  apply (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm.injective
  simpa only [φ.tomitaCoreProduct_inverse, map_smul] using
    smul_mul_assoc c ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ) ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm η)

/-- The same existing complex scalar action is compatible with original product in its second factor. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreProduct_smul_right (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (c : ℂ) (ξ η : φ.tomitaCore) :
    φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ ξ (c • η) = c • φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ ξ η := by
  apply (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm.injective
  simpa only [φ.tomitaCoreProduct_inverse, map_smul] using
    mul_smul_comm c ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ) ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm η)

/-- The original source algebra maps as the same actual nonunital star algebra into its weighted image. -/
def Weight.toTomitaCoreStarAlgHom (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] φ.tomitaCore := by
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  refine
    { toFun := φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ
      map_zero' := map_zero (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ)
      map_add' := fun x y => map_add (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ) x y
      map_mul' := fun x y => (φ.tomitaCoreProduct_original hφ x y).symm
      map_smul' := fun c x => (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).map_smul c x
      map_star' := fun x => (φ.preTomitaCore_apply hφ x).symm }

/-- The actual inverse weighted-core identification retains the original nonunital algebra and star. -/
def Weight.fromTomitaCoreStarAlgHom (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCore →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra := by
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  refine
    { toFun := (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
      map_zero' := map_zero (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm
      map_add' := fun ξ η => map_add (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ η
      map_mul' := fun ξ η => φ.tomitaCoreProduct_inverse hφ ξ η
      map_smul' := fun c ξ => (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm.map_smul c ξ
      map_star' := fun ξ => φ.preTomitaCore_inverse hφ ξ }

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.TomitaCoreLeftRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.VonNeumannAlgebra.Generated

/-!
# The actual von Neumann algebra generated by the original weighted core

The original completed left regular representation provides the actual
bounded coefficient operators on the same weight Hilbert completion.
Their existing generatedBy construction is the original associated VN
algebra candidate. The same coefficients restrict to that actual carrier
with unchanged original operator values.

This defines the source object used by Connes V.3 Definition 6 and the
original Aφ paragraph. Original density, closability, nondegeneracy and
identification with M and φ remain source theorem outputs. No isomorphism,
weight, source model or desired generated-algebra equality is a premise.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original associated algebra candidate is generated by the same actual completed core coefficients. -/
def Weight.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    VonNeumannAlgebra φ.GNS := by
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  exact VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy (Set.range (φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ))

/-- Every original core coefficient belongs to the actual generated source algebra. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_mem_generated (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ : φ.tomitaCore) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ ξ ∈ φ.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra hφ := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  exact VonNeumannAlgebra.subset_generatedBy _ (Set.mem_range_self ξ)

/-- The actual carrier is the literal double commutant of the original coefficient star algebra. -/
theorem Weight.coe_tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    (φ.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra hφ : Set (φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS)) =
      Set.centralizer (Set.centralizer (StarAlgebra.adjoin ℂ
        (Set.range (φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ)) : Set (φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS))) := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  exact VonNeumannAlgebra.coe_generatedBy _

/-- Containment of the associated algebra is exactly containment of the original core coefficients. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra_le_iff (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (N : VonNeumannAlgebra φ.GNS) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra hφ ≤ N ↔
      ∀ ξ : φ.tomitaCore, φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ ξ ∈ N := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  change VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy (Set.range (φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ)) ≤ N ↔ _
  rw [VonNeumannAlgebra.generatedBy_le_iff]
  exact Set.range_subset_iff

/-- The same original coefficient representation maps into its actual generated VN carrier. -/
def Weight.tomitaCoreToGenerated (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCore →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] φ.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra hφ := by
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  exact (φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ).codRestrict
    (φ.tomitaCoreGeneratedVonNeumannAlgebra hφ).toStarSubalgebra.toNonUnitalStarSubalgebra
      (φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_mem_generated hφ)

/-- Restricting to the actual generated carrier keeps every original bounded operator value. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreToGenerated_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ : φ.tomitaCore) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    (φ.tomitaCoreToGenerated hφ ξ : φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS) = φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ ξ := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  rfl

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.TomitaCoreAlgebra
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSLeftRepresentation

/-!
# The original weighted core has its completed left regular representation

The original two-square algebra and its actual weighted GNS image are
identified by their existing source algebra maps. Compose the inverse
image map, the actual ambient core subtype and the existing completed
weight left representation. The resulting nonunital star representation
acts on the same original weighted Hilbert completion.

Every core product has the literal value Lambda(a*x). The actual complex
scalar, product and star laws follow from the existing star homomorphisms.
No normed-ring estimate, star-continuity, density, star closability or
associated-algebra/weight conclusion is supplied as an input.
Source: Connes, Noncommutative Geometry (1994), V.3 Definition 6 and the
original Aφ paragraph, preserved OCR 14358--14386.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original weighted core acts by its same actual completed weight left representation. -/
def Weight.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCore →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS) := by
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  exact (φ.gnsLeftRepresentation.comp
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra)).comp
      (φ.fromTomitaCoreStarAlgHom hφ)

/-- Every weighted source coefficient is the original completed operator of its actual core preimage. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_apply (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ : φ.tomitaCore) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ ξ =
      φ.gnsLeftRepresentation ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ : A) := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  rfl

/-- The same representation keeps every original two-square-finite algebra coefficient. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_original (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (a : φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ a) = φ.gnsLeftRepresentation (a : A) := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  rw [φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- The actual completed operator acts on every original finite-square vector by original multiplication. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_gnsMap (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ : φ.tomitaCore) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ ξ (φ.gnsMap x) =
      φ.gnsMap (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul ((φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).symm ξ : A) x) := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  rw [φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_apply]
  exact φ.gnsLeftRepresentation_gnsMap _ x

/-- The original completed left action preserves the literal weighted core and its original product. -/
theorem Weight.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_coreAction (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0)
    (ξ η : φ.tomitaCore) :
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ;
    letI := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ;
    φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation hφ ξ (η : φ.GNS) = (φ.tomitaCoreProduct hφ ξ η : φ.GNS) := by
  let := φ.tomitaCoreNonUnitalRing hφ
  let := φ.tomitaCoreStar hφ
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).surjective ξ
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (φ.tomitaCoreEquiv hφ).surjective η
  rw [φ.tomitaCoreLeftRepresentation_original, φ.tomitaCoreProduct_original,
    φ.tomitaCoreEquiv_apply, φ.tomitaCoreEquiv_apply,
    φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap_apply, φ.finiteStarSquareGNSMap_apply]
  rw [φ.gnsLeftRepresentation_gnsMap]
  rfl

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
